case_id.description: Stable identifier used in result records.

source_root.description: Default source root. Can be overridden by --root.

source_root_candidates.description: Optional fallback roots for other machines or mounts. The loader prefers the first existing path.

source_root_by_profile.description: Optional named roots keyed by environment profile. Set SKILLCLAW_PATH_PROFILE to prefer one.

binary.description: Path to the target binary relative to source_root.

expected_artifacts.description: Optional artifacts that the agent should generate for vulnerability confirmation or PoC validation.

repro.description: Optional reproducibility harness describing how to build, run, and recognize a successful trigger.

confirmation.description: Optional confirmation-state metadata that distinguishes the currently confirmed runtime path from the final target evidence path.

maturity.description: Current confirmation layer for this case, such as scaffold, artifact, behavior-backed, asan-backed, or intermediate-confirmed-path.

current_claim.description: What the project can truthfully claim today about this case.

target_claim.description: What stronger evidence would justify final promotion.

accepted_runtime_claim.description: Optional currently accepted runtime confirmation claim, used when the stable runtime path is weaker than the final publication claim.

promotion_blockers.description: Reasons the case should not yet be promoted to its target claim.

promotion_targets.description: Signals or conditions required before promotion.

benchmark.description: Optional benchmark-policy metadata that states whether this case is exploratory, runnable, confirmed, or suitable for current-runset or publication-facing statistics.

maturity.description: Engineering maturity of this case as an evaluation object.

benchmark_tier.description: Current benchmark tier for this case.

include_in_current_runs.description: Whether this case may be included in the current engineering runset.

publication_ready.description: Whether this case is strong enough to be counted in a publication-facing benchmark table without an extra maturity caveat.

primary_evidence.description: Strongest current evidence backing this case.

task_profile.description: Optional task-shape metadata used for prompt rendering, retrieval cues, and post-run skill attribution. These fields should describe analysis modality rather than a specific CVE or project name.

bug_class.description: Human-readable bug family such as memory_safety, state_machine_oob, or cwe120.

notes.description: Optional compact note clarifying how to interpret the task profile.

blind_workspace.description: Optional blind-test workspace policy. Agent-visible runs should use agent_root and avoid oracle-only paths or CVE-labeled artifacts.

agent_root.description: Default root to use for blind-* modes. Can still be overridden by --root.

agent_root_candidates.description: Optional fallback blind workspaces for other machines or mounts. The loader prefers the first existing path.

agent_root_by_profile.description: Optional named blind workspaces keyed by environment profile. Set SKILLCLAW_PATH_PROFILE to prefer one.

validator_root.description: Optional oracle/root path used by validators during blind-* modes. Defaults to target.source_root.

validator_root_candidates.description: Optional fallback validator roots for other machines or mounts. The loader prefers the first existing path.

validator_root_by_profile.description: Optional named validator roots keyed by environment profile. Set SKILLCLAW_PATH_PROFILE to prefer one.

oracle_only_paths.description: Paths under source_root that should not be exposed to the agent during blind runs.

neutral_artifacts.description: Optional neutralized files that may be created in the blind workspace for agent-visible analysis.

setup_commands.description: Commands executed after copying source_root into agent_root to prepare a blind workspace.

artifact_type.description: Optional for artifact_exists. When omitted and min_size_bytes is set, the loader treats it as a file check.

success_markers.description: For artifact_exec: output markers that should appear when the generated artifact runs correctly.

marker_match.description: For artifact_exec: how success_markers are matched when markers are required. Prefer all for confirmation-grade validators.

expect_crash.description: For asan_command or artifact_exec: true means a sanitizer/crash report is expected for vulnerable builds; false means no sanitizer report is expected for fixed builds.

sanitizer_markers.description: For asan_command: output markers that identify sanitizer or crash evidence.

expected_stack_patterns.description: For asan_command: source files, functions, or stack substrings expected in the sanitizer report.

scoring.description: Optional scoring policy. When omitted, code-level defaults are used.

notes_ref.description: Optional pointer to a longer case dossier under docs/cases/.
